title: Ivo and the Ember
author: Kestrel Crane
blurb: Marguerite Blackwood, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
